places.name: Miles City
places.note: An animal broke into the shed and carried off Gus's severed leg; Call has the coffin rebuilt and buys an old buggy to haul it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Heading south from Miles City, Call rides a while with a band of friendly Crow curious about the coffin.
places.location_hint: south of Miles City toward Wyoming

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: Call travels eleven days across it without meeting anyone; the mule loses flesh at his pace.

places.name: Powder River
places.note: The reinforced coffin takes hard jolts in the gullies nearby but holds together.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Nearing it, Call meets five drunk young Indians who beg food and briefly threaten him.

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Call rides a mile off it, hearing ducks and geese all day.

places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Call delivers Gus's letters; Lorena stands by the coffin all night and faints, while Clara angrily berates Call as he leaves.
places.location_hint: Allen horse ranch near the Platte in Nebraska; a ridge there holds Clara's sons' graves

places.name: Milk River
places.note: Call keeps thinking of the men and the boy he left there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Gus wanted burial at a picnic spot there where he and Clara once courted; Clara calls the plan foolish.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July is noted as the young sheriff from there.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Dish regrets ever coming to the town.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Call with Gus's coffin
groups.hint: just leaving the Nebraska ranch with the coffin in a buggy, headed for Texas
